findings.summary: The production data-protection Keychain requires a correctly signed/provisioned host. Unsigned or entitlement-less tools fail closed; deployment signing is outside this issue. Manual evidence proves the signed path and negative paths.
removeFingerprint intentionally ignores pre-start cancellation because cleanup withdraws trust; documented and tested, but integrators must not treat cleanup failure as success.
Prompt UI, TLS wiring and re-pair/revocation workflows are out of scope and remain follow-on integration. Callers must never map .prompt to accept.

The test file is large (1785 lines, 56 declarations), increasing maintenance cost, but it is deterministic, partitioned, strict-lint clean and provides exhaustive security/race/manual-harness coverage. No follow-up issue required during M1 unless maintainability degrades.
